description: This file defines classes and functions for reading and writing serialized PyTorch model data in a ZIP archive format, including stream readers and writers, record iteration, and archive handling.

classes.name: ChunkRecordIterator
classes.description: Iterator for reading chunks of records from a ZIP archive.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamReader
classes.description: Class for reading serialized PyTorch models from a ZIP archive.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamWriter
classes.description: Class for writing serialized PyTorch models into a ZIP archive.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieve a data record by name, returning a tuple of data pointer and size.

methods.name: writeRecord
methods.description: Write a data record with a specified name and data buffer.

methods.name: createChunkReaderIter
methods.description: Create an iterator to read a record in chunks.
